name: For the Trees
source:
You're not doing well. At all. During a depressing Halloween night in, you get a call that dampens your mood even more – but one that pushes you to take action.

In a desperate attempt to find some semblance of joy, you head out for your friendly neighborhood haunted tunnel to get some kicks, or at least some spooks. There, you meet someone new, and run into an old friend. Will one of them help you find what you're looking for?


[From [url=https://differenteagletragedy.itch.io/for-the-trees]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你做得不好。完全没有。在一个令人沮丧的万圣节之夜，你接到一通电话，这让你的心情更加沮丧，但却促使你采取行动。

为了寻找一些看似快乐的绝望尝试，你前往你友好的邻居闹鬼的隧道寻找一些刺激，或者至少是一些幽灵。在那里，你会遇到新朋友，也会遇到老朋友。其中之一会帮助你找到你想要的东西吗？


[来自[url=https://differenteagletragedy.itch.io/for-the-trees]itch.io[/url]]
